messages.content: 這家企業的營收為15000美元，總成本為22000美元，回報率是多少？

function.name: investment_analysis_calculate_profit

message.content:
營收（Revenue） = 15,000 USD  
總成本（Cost） = 22,000 USD  

**1. 計算淨利潤 (Net Profit)**  
\[
\text{Net Profit} = \text{Revenue} - \text{Cost} = 15{,}000 - 22{,}000 = -7{,}000 \text{ USD}
\]

**2. 計算回報率（Profit Margin）**  
回報率通常指「淨利潤佔營收的比例」，即：

\[
\text{Return Rate} = \frac{\text{Net Profit}}{\text{Revenue}} \times 100\%
= \frac{-7{,}000}{15{,}000} \times 100\%
= -46.67\%
\]

> **結果**：該企業的回報率為 **-46.67 %**，表示營收不足以覆蓋成本，導致虧損。

如果你想知道其他指標（例如 ROI = 淨利潤 ÷ 成本），也可以告訴我！
message.reasoning: The user asks: "這家企業的營收為15000美元，總成本為22000美元，回報率是多少？" They want the return rate. Return rate likely means net profit / total revenue? Or net profit margin? They gave revenue 15000, cost 22000. Net profit = revenue - cost = -7000. Return rate maybe negative 46.67%? Actually net profit margin = (revenue - cost)/revenue = -7000/15000 = -0.4667 = -46.67%. Or ROI = net profit / cost? That would be -7000/22000 = -0.318 = -31.8%. Usually return rate refers to profit margin. So answer: -46.67%. Provide explanation.
